name: Block Creator
description: Workflow that creates new block definitions (block.json + system-prompt.md) from a contract specification. Iterates based on test results to improve the block until it passes the contract.

block-generation.description: Create a valid block.json with all required fields

tests.prompt: Create a block.json for an agent that implements the 'code-reviewer' contract. It should use claude-sonnet-4-6 as its model.
Create a block.json for a 'commit-message-writer' agent block

tests.description: Block declares its capabilities matching the contract
tests.prompt: Create a block.json for an agent implementing 'maestro-assistant' contract which requires capabilities: conversation, tool-calling, structured-output

prompt-writing.description: Write an effective system-prompt.md adapted to the target model

tests.description: System prompt has clear sections and instructions
tests.prompt: Write a system-prompt.md for a code-reviewer agent. The agent should review code for bugs, style, and performance.

tests.description: System prompt describes available tools when the agent uses tools
tests.prompt: Write a system-prompt.md for an agent that uses file-read, file-write, and shell-execute tools. Include tool descriptions.

iterative-improvement.description: Read test results, diagnose failures, and improve the block

tests.description: Correctly identifies why a test failed and proposes a fix
tests.prompt: The test 'basic-response' failed with check type 'non-empty' (minLength: 20). The agent responded with 'Hi.' (3 chars). What's wrong and how would you fix the system prompt?

tests.description: Produces an improved version after seeing failures

turns.prompt: Here are the test results for my code-reviewer agent: 'review-quality' FAILED (check: contains 'suggestion'), 'code-format' PASSED. What should I change?
Now generate the updated system-prompt.md with those fixes

model-adaptation.description: Adapt block configuration for different model tiers

tests.description: Adjusts prompt and config for a smaller model
tests.prompt: I have a code-reviewer block using claude-opus-4-6. Create a variant for claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. What changes would you make to the system prompt and config?

tests.description: Adapted variant still targets the same contract
tests.prompt: When adapting a block from opus to haiku, should the contract reference change?

scoring.description: Score = sum(feature.weight * feature.score). Block creator must reliably produce valid, well-prompted blocks that pass their target contracts.
